The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

(Published by Authority)PART I : SECTION (I) — GENERAL

Government Notifications

1A- PG 6814- 154 (08/2024) This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

Forest Conservation ordinance

The order under Sub Section 3 (1) that has to be read with Sub Section 4 (1) of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451), No. 16 of 1907, as amended by Act, No. 13 of 1966 (reprint), No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009.

The Order

By virtute of the powers vested in me under Sub Section 3 (1) that has to be read with Sub Section 4 (1) of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451), No. 16 of 1907, as amended by Act, No. 13 of 1966 (reprint), No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, I, Minister of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation do by this Order declare the state lands of the extent 445.0 hectares bounded by the limits set forth in the Schedules 1, 2, 3, 4 & 5 hereto as Irampaikkulam 2 Reserved Forest from 07th day of August, 2024.

Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation.

Ministry of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation,No. 07, Hector Kobbekaduwa Mawatha, Colombo 07,07th day of August 2024.

FOREST Conservation ordinance

Notification

By virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 63 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451), No. 16 of 1907, as amended by Act, No. 13 of 1966 (reprint), No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, I do by this notification notify that the Irampaikkulam 2 Reserved Forest mentioned in the above order is subjected to the sole control of the Conservator General of Forests.

Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation.Ministry of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation,No. 07, Hector Kobbekaduwa Mawatha, Colombo 07,07th day of August 2024.
